Mustapha Abdul Rahman, (born 18 March 1991) known by his stage name Rudebwoy Ranking is a Ghanaian reggae-dancehall artist. He has been active since 2012 and is known for his strong lyrics about social issues mixed with dancehall and reggae beats. He grew up in Nima, Accra, where he learned music.
He started performing at concerts across Ghana in 2015 and won the Discovery of the Year award at the Bass Awards the same year. In 2016, he released his first album, Elevation-Time. Over the years, he has worked with popular Ghanaian artists like Shatta Wale, Samini, and Edem.
Rudebwoy Ranking passed away on April 24, 2023, at Ridge Hospital in Accra due to health complications.
